environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed in EKS pod with pgBouncer 1.21 sidecar in transaction pooling mode (pool_mode=transaction). pgBouncer configuration sets disable_pqexec=1 and max_packet_size=4096. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress from the application pod to only the pgBouncer sidecar on port 6432 (no direct DB access). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy with custom action DENY is applied matching paths with prefix '/debug' for any source principal not in the mesh-internal 'ops-team' ServiceAccount. The pgBouncer instance connects to the upstream RDS PostgreSQL with a fixed service account credential (not user-supplied), and the application's DB_HOST points to localhost:6432 (the sidecar). The X-DB-Credential header value is ignored at the pgBouncer layer since authentication is handled by pgBouncer's auth_file with a single pooler service account.

config.network_policy: egress only to 127.0.0.1:6432, ingress from istio-proxy
config.istio_authz: DENY action on path prefix /debug for principals not in ops-team SA
config.credential_handling: pgBouncer uses fixed service account credential from Secrets Manager; user-supplied X-DB-Credential header has no effect on actual DB authentication
